entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: A grand month-long exposition in Ghirapur organized by the Consulate, with inventing competitions called exhibitions; it ends in a duel and the Consulate's confiscation of the inventions.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The thriving city at the heart of Kaladesh's Great Aether Boom where the Fair is held.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane of the Great Aether Boom, ruled by the Consulate.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: The ruling body of Kaladesh, which organized the Fair and sought to collect, test and license inventions for control.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Senior Consulate Inspector and planeswalker who asks the Gatewatch for help against the renegades.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: An organization of planeswalkers focused on threats from without; its members join the fight at the Grand Exhibition.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker and Gatewatch member born on Kaladesh, who remembers the Consulate's role in her parents' deaths and returns to oppose it.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and Gatewatch member who follows Chandra to Kaladesh.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker and Gatewatch member who travels to Kaladesh with Dovin and opposes the Consulate reinforcements.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: A member of the Gatewatch who reports that Chandra and Liliana planeswalked away.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The Consulate's head judge, a master of metal who duels Pia, orders the confiscation of the inventions and plans a Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A supremely skilled artificer and the Renegade Prime, forced to surrender to the Consulate and later dueled by Tezzeret.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: A rebel force that repeatedly disrupts the Consulate's preparations for the Fair.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Dovin Baan asks the Gatewatch for help.

entities.name: Aether Spire
entities.description: The site of a secretive laboratory to which Tezzeret withdraws.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An inventor whose space-folding device Tezzeret takes.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: A technology Tezzeret planned to develop to pass through extraplanar space.

events.summary: The Consulate holds the Inventors' Fair, a month-long exposition in Ghirapur drawing inventors and spectators, while quietly seeking to collect and license technologies.
events.quote: a grand, month-long exposition held in the thriving city of Ghirapur

events.summary: Consulate decree reduces aether allocation to under-utilized neighborhoods during the Fairgrounds' construction, upsetting citizens and inciting revolutionary support.
events.quote: However, the reduction in aether upset the citizens and inventors of Kaladesh, inciting revolutionary support.

events.summary: Renegades repeatedly disrupt the preparations for the Fair.
events.quote: preparations for the Fair became repeatedly disrupted by renegades.

events.summary: Dovin Baan travels to Ravnica the day before the Fair to ask the Gatewatch for help; the Gatewatch declines as the issue is internal to one plane.
events.quote: traveled to Ravnica the day before the Fair began to ask for the Gatewatch

events.summary: Chandra, born on Kaladesh, planeswalks there, quickly followed by Liliana.
events.quote: She planeswalks to Kaladesh, quickly followed by Lilliana Vess

events.summary: Dovin and Nissa travel to Kaladesh, gather Consulate reinforcements and find Tezzeret confronting Pia, Liliana and Chandra.
events.quote: Dovin and Nissa travel to Kaladesh, where Dovin gets Consulate reinforcements

events.summary: Pia is forced to surrender to Consulate custody despite Chandra, Liliana and Nissa opposing the reinforcements.
events.quote: Pia was forced to surrender to Consulate custody.

events.summary: At the Grand Exhibition Pia is paraded before a jeering crowd.
events.quote: Pia was paraded in front of a jeering and heckling crowd.

events.summary: Tezzeret duels Pia and sends an attack clearly meant to kill her.
events.quote: Tezzeret sent an attack at Pia that was clearly intended to kill her.

events.summary: Chandra drops her disguise and saves Pia, and the Gatewatch joins the fight against Tezzeret and his guards.
events.quote: The Gatewatch all joined the fighting

events.summary: Consulate enforcers seize all the inventions submitted for judging 'for safekeeping' while the crowd flees.
events.quote: seized all the wondrous prizes submitted for judging

events.summary: Tezzeret withdraws to a secretive laboratory in the Aether Spire with Rashmi's device to develop a Planar Bridge.
events.quote: Tezzeret withdrew to a secretive laboratory in the Aether Spire

relations.quote: Senior Consulate Inspector and planeswalker Dovin Baan
one member of The Gatewatch, Chandra Nalaar

relations.note: Tezzeret tries to kill Pia in their duel.
relations.quote: Tezzeret sent an attack at Pia that was clearly intended to kill her.
She was saved only by the sudden intervention from Chandra

relations.note: Tezzeret acts as the Consulate's head judge.
Ghirapur is a city on Kaladesh, called Avishkar.
